images.name: Orca Acquisitions, LLC
images.subsector: Merchant power generation and industrial steam
images.description: Orca Acquisitions, LLC is an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI and Olympus Power joint-venture platform that indirectly owns Walleye Power, LLC through Walleye Energy Holdings, LLC. Walleye owns and operates the Bay Shore merchant-power and industrial-steam facility in Oregon, Ohio. A June 2026 FERC filing reports 136 MW of summer-rated steam generation and a 16 MW oil-fired unit. ArcLight Orca Holdings, LLC holds 95% of Orca's Class A managing interests, appoints two management-committee members and controls day-to-day decisions. Olympus affiliates hold the remaining 5% of Class A interests and all non-managing, non-voting Class B interests. The exact overall economic ownership split is not publicly disclosed. Orca is the single PortCo; Walleye, its holding company, Bay Shore and the individual generating units are subsidiaries or assets beneath the platform. No Orca-specific sale or pending ownership transfer was identified through August 14, 2026.

milestones.event: An amended and restated LLC agreement dated July 25, 2016 documented Orca Acquisitions' ArcLight and Olympus ownership and governance structure.
Orca subsidiary Walleye entered into an asset-purchase agreement to acquire the Bay Shore Generating Facility from FirstEnergy Solutions affiliates.
Walleye Energy, LLC changed its name to Walleye Power, LLC before the Bay Shore acquisition closed.
Walleye completed the acquisition of the Bay Shore Generating Facility.
